Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the correctly gathered dates—It’s Our Life! (2005-12-07) vs. Maximum Ride (2016-08-30/2016-09-30)—and incorrectly concluded that Maximum Ride came out earlier. The added claim that it “predates … by about 3 months” further shows a logical/comparison error, not a data retrieval issue.
